Across NatureWalk’s wooden welcoming bridge, and down Flatwoods Forest Loop, you will find our stunning Sunset at Seagrove vacation rental property, offering luxurious accommodations for up to 12 guests in 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. Designed and built from the inside out to provide a luxurious vacation experience with all the amenities, including screened-in porch AND balcony with views of the peaceful pond, Sunset at Seagrove is sure to have you coming back year after year!



Sunset at Seagrove has 2 King Master Suites and a Bunkroom with Full-over-Full, so there is plenty of room for the whole family.  The stocked kitchen means that you don't have to give up family meals on vacation!  Of course, there's plenty of Dining (as well as Entertainment!) options nearby, on top of hiking, biking and so much more!  At the end of the day, hang out on the screened-in balcony or back porch, grab a glass of wine and take in the view of the pond!



The NatureWalk Gathering Place is located approximately .4 miles from Sunset at Seagrove, featuring 2 pools (1 seasonally heated!), Kiddie Pool, Jacuzzi, children’s playground, communal grills and more!  The NatureWalk beach trail, located nearby, is a relaxing nature trail that meanders through the state forest, ending at a sleepy side road (San Juan Ave) with direct access to the beach.



The provided bikes means getting to this beach access is a breeze!



30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country’s most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.



This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed every turn!



Enjoy our 6-Seater, Street-Legal Golf Cart & 6 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes, to cruise down 30A in Style!

Quick rides to the beach, Seaside, Seagrove, Watercolor and more!!



Beach Access:

Located near Lilly Lane Beach Trail, where NatureWalk guests can enjoy a private nature path to the beach, you will find our breath-taking NatureWalk home. Bike or stroll serenely through the nature preserves to the San Juan beach access or other nearby public beach accesses.



Nearby Restaurants:

reviews.text:
The property is up-to-date & nicely furnished. Roomy with multiple areas to gather or be alone. Bedding & mattresses slept well. Plenty of towels, terry, etc. Expected amenities were all there & functional. The pools were not over- crowded any day or afternoon we were there.
Parking is tight! The 1 garage space will fit a small SUV, but is so tight you have to pull all the way to the wall & then pull the door down. There literally was not enough room to walk in front of or behind the vehicle when the door is down. The other 2 spaces outside also only fit a smaller vehicle/ SUV. We had to parallel park our Suburban over the 2 spaces otherwise it would’ve been in the road.
The descriptions of proximity to the public beach accesses are misleading. Yes, it is a very short walk or bike ride to the bike path, but the walk or bike ride from there is a haul if you have gear &/or little people to take. Both of the nearest public accesses had very little parking for cars, golf carts or bikes so you have to go early if you expect to park. Also, 10 x 10 tents & Shibumi -Mini shades are permitted on the public beaches, but original-size Shibumi shades are not allowed. The closest access is the Seaside Cabanaman Hut, but you can only use this access if you are staying in Seaside or Watercolor, OR if you rent chairs & umbrellas from them. No personal chairs, tents or umbrellas are allowed from other properties at the Seaside Beach access. It is worth the expense though if you plan to beach most of the day & want to go back & forth to the Seaside town square shops, restaurants & food trucks. You have to get there early too if you expect to park.
As for any issues with the property itself, there were a few live roaches seen under the kitchen sink & by the dishwasher during our stay. The door handle to the 1st floor master closet fell off when I opened it the 1st time. A lower kitchen cabinet door was attached by 1 hinge on arrival & fell completely off later. The golf cart had no windshield wipers & there was a crack in the lower right corner of the windshield.
Would definitely search for other properties closer to the beach for the expense if we were to visit here again.
